events.head: Colgate reportedly explores sale of Softsoap, Irish Spring and Speed Stick
events.sum: Sources told Reuters Colgate is working with Goldman Sachs on divesting a few mass personal care brands that together could fetch over $1B; the company declined to comment.

events.head: Oddity Q2 2026 revenue down 25%, sees sequential improvement in Q3
events.sum: Q2 2026 net revenue fell to $181M from $241M, with net income of $13M and adjusted EBITDA of $13M. Q3 revenue is guided down about 5% and FY2026 down about 19% (adjusted EBITDA of $30-32M); about $163M of shares have been repurchased year to date.

events.head: CVC explores ~$2B sale of Dr Teal's owner Arthēa (ex-PDC Brands)
events.sum: Reuters sources say CVC Capital Partners is working with Moelis and William Blair on an early-stage sale of Arthēa, owner of Dr Teal's, Cantu and Bodycology, which could value it at about $2B; CVC bought the business for $1.43B in 2017.

events.head: Rodan + Fields expands to 400 Ulta stores and Amazon Premium Beauty

events.head: Wella Files for US IPO as Revenue Reaches US$2.94 Billion
events.sum: KKR-backed Wella Company filed to list on the NYSE under ticker WELA after returning to profit, with fiscal-year revenue of $2.94 billion (up from $2.69 billion) and net income of $2.7 million versus a $44.6 million prior-year loss. Proceeds are earmarked for debt repayment and restructuring-related tax costs.

events.head: Australia's ACCC Clears Kimberly-Clark's $48.7B Kenvue Acquisition, Subject to Divestment
events.sum: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission approved Kimberly-Clark's acquisition of Kenvue on condition that Kimberly-Clark divest Kenvue's Carefree and Stayfree period-care brands in Australia to preserve competition. The global deal remains subject to an EU antitrust deadline of Sept 29 and deeper China review.

events.head: Yatsen Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results

events.head: Yellow Wood Partners Agrees to Acquire Nestlé's Holistic Health Platform
events.sum: Private equity firm Yellow Wood Partners agreed to buy Nestlé's Holistic Health vitamins, minerals and supplements platform — including Nature's Bounty, Nuun, Osteo Bi-Flex and Gard — for $1.0 billion, expected to close in H1 2027.

events.head: Victoria Beckham Holdings Returns to Profit as Beauty Drives Group Growth
events.sum: Victoria Beckham Holdings reported its first operating profit since launching 18 years ago, with 2025 revenue up 15% to £129.8 million driven by the beauty division.

events.head: Skyline Beauty Group Acquires Lumin and Meridian From Pangaea Holdings
events.sum: Skyline Beauty Group acquired men's skincare brand Lumin and body-grooming brand Meridian, which together generated roughly $35M in trailing sales. Terms were undisclosed; it's Skyline's second acquisition in five months following LilyAna Naturals. Off-watchlist companies — market intelligence.

events.head: Shein Completes Hong Kong IPO as Listing Reshapes Investor Obligations
events.sum: Shein completed its Hong Kong IPO, raising roughly $1.7 billion at a valuation of about $26 billion — down sharply from its 2022 peak of $98.2 billion — a capital-markets event relevant to the K-beauty brands that reach shoppers through its cross-border marketplace.

events.head: Dollar Shave Club Acquires Truly Beauty in First-Ever Acquisition
events.sum: Dollar Shave Club, under CEO Larry Bodner, acquired Gen Z-focused body care brand Truly Beauty as it builds a multi-brand personal care platform. Financial terms were not disclosed; both brands will retain separate identities while integrating backend operations. Off-watchlist companies — market intelligence.

events.head: LG H&H Expands Dr.Groot Across 424 Sephora Stores in the US

events.head: Ulta Beauty Beats Wall Street Expectations, Raises Full-year Forecasts Amid Strong Q2 Performance
events.sum: Bolstered by an 8.9 percent sales increase, international expansion and new initiatives, the beauty retailer raised its outlook for continued growth.

events.head: Ulta Beauty beats Q2 estimates, raises full-year 2026 guidance
events.sum: Ulta reported Q2 FY2026 net sales up 8.9% to $3.0B and diluted EPS of $6.55 (vs. $6.17 est.), boosted by comp-sales growth and the Space NK acquisition; it raised FY2026 EPS guidance to $28.70-$29.00 and net sales growth guidance to 6.7%-7.2%.

events.head: Regent to acquire Avon North America from LG H&H, reuniting Avon under common ownership
events.sum: Regent affiliate Stratford Worldwide agreed to buy LG H&H's stake in The Avon Company, reunifying Avon North America with Avon's international operations (which Regent already owns after its January 2026 purchase from Natura &Co) for the first time since 2016. Financial terms were not disclosed; the deal is expected to close September 1. LG H&H had bought the business for $125M in 2019.

events.head: KKR buys Japanese beauty platform Ci FLAVORS from L Catterton and founder
events.sum: KKR agreed to acquire Ci FLAVORS, a Japanese beauty and lifestyle brand platform spanning haircare, skincare and body care (including &honey and MOROCCAN BEAUTY), from L Catterton and other shareholders for an undisclosed amount. Founder Yusaku Horiuchi and CEO Yoshiaki Okura will reinvest alongside KKR.

events.head: Proya H1 2026 profit jumps 46% on Flower Knows gain; revenue flat
events.sum: First-half revenue was RMB5.37B, up 0.24% YoY, while attributable net profit rose 46.3% to RMB1.17B, lifted by a one-off gain from consolidating Flower Knows.

events.head: KIKO Milano enters Uruguay with an €8.55M expansion plan
events.sum: KIKO Milano will open its first Uruguay store at Montevideo Shopping in late October in partnership with Grupo Antelo, investing €8.55M to build an eight-store network over five years and create around 100 jobs. Strong performance could open the door to a subsequent expansion into Argentina.

events.head: Adore Beauty posts record FY26 revenue as store network triples but EBITDA falls
events.sum: The Australian beauty retailer reported record FY2026 revenue of A$207.3M (+4.3%), helped by an $18.6M contribution from its store network which grew from 7 to 20 locations, but underlying EBITDA fell 39% to A$3.8M on investment costs. It is targeting at least 10% revenue growth in FY27.

events.head: Wipro Consumer Care buys 60% of Dermatouch for ₹3.88B to enter digital-first premium skincare
events.sum: Wipro Consumer Care and Lighting agreed to acquire a 60% stake in Indian skincare brand Dermatouch at an enterprise value of ₹3.88B (about US$44M), its entry into India's digital-first premium skincare segment. Dermatouch gains Wipro's distribution reach and R&D.

events.head: Target lifts full-year outlook as Q2 sales rise 5.3% and beauty grows high single digits
events.sum: Q2 net sales rose 5.3% to US$26.5B with comparable sales up 3.8% and digital comps up 8.7%. Beauty delivered high single-digit growth and Target raised full-year net sales guidance to roughly 5%, a point above prior expectations — read closely by Ulta, whose shop-in-shop agreement with Target concludes this month.

events.head: Essity to acquire Kenvue's Brazil feminine care business for $284M
events.sum: Essity agreed to buy Kenvue's Brazilian feminine care business — the Carefree, Sempre Livre and o.b. brands — for $284M on a cash- and debt-free basis, expanding its Latin America feminine care platform. The unit generated ~BRL 800M in trailing net sales; closing is expected Q2 2027, contingent on the Kimberly-Clark/Kenvue transaction completing.

events.head: Shanghai Jahwa H1 2026 revenue up 9%, net profit up 43%
events.sum: First-half 2026 revenue was RMB3.79B, up 9.0% YoY, and net profit rose 43.4% to RMB380M.

events.head: PROYA partners with Ulta Beauty to enter US prestige skincare
events.sum: Chinese skincare brand PROYA will join Ulta Beauty's prestige portfolio, launching its Advanced Firming and Original Repair collections in 400 stores nationwide and online this November. No financial terms were disclosed.

events.head: Estée Lauder returns to growth as FY2026 sales rise 5% and margins expand
events.sum: Full-year net sales reached $15.05B with 3% organic growth, marking a return to growth after a difficult stretch; Q4 organic sales rose 5% and operating margin expanded 320bps for the year. Shares jumped on a bullish FY2027 outlook.

events.head: Coty beats Q4 revenue expectations but losses widen, and names Soraya Benchikh CFO
events.sum: Q4 sales for the year ended 30 June rose 1% with like-for-like improving sequentially to -1%, despite an estimated 1% drag from the Middle East conflict. Sales, profit and cash flow came in ahead of expectations on cost control, but the quarterly loss widened and guidance is for a low-to-mid single-digit revenue decline. Former British American Tobacco finance chief Soraya Benchikh becomes CFO.

events.head: CVC Capital invests KRW300B in K-beauty distributor Silicon2
events.sum: CVC Asia will acquire a 9.23% stake in Korean K-beauty distribution platform Silicon2 via newly issued convertible shares, valuing the company at an enterprise value of roughly $2.1B. Proceeds will fund international distribution and logistics expansion.

events.head: River Associates acquires personal care manufacturer Diamond Wipes
events.sum: The Chattanooga private equity firm acquired Diamond Wipes, a North American contract manufacturer of disposable wet wipes and liquid-fill personal care products, from Nolan Capital. The transaction closed on 7 August and was funded from River VIII; add-on acquisitions are planned. Terms undisclosed.

events.head: Amorepacific takes Mamonde into India in an exclusive Nykaa partnership
events.sum: Mamonde debuted in India exclusively on Nykaa, the country's largest beauty platform, with ten products built around its Rose HA and Peony BHA lines and Hyper-Flora technology. The launch extends Amorepacific's K-beauty push beyond its Americas and EMEA momentum into a fast-growing market.

events.head: Douglas Q3 sales slip 2% and adjusted EBITDA falls 19.4% as it reviews its store network
events.sum: Group sales fell 2.0% to €987.8M with like-for-like down 4.5% and adjusted EBITDA down 19.4% to €127.5M, on weak premium demand in Germany, France and the Netherlands. Guidance for FY25/26 was held at €4.58–4.63B revenue and a 15% adjusted EBITDA margin; exclusive brands grew double digits.

events.head: Sephora partners with Glam42 to bring Sephora Collection to Israel
events.sum: A distribution partnership putting the Sephora Collection own-brand range into the Israeli market through local operator Glam42, extending the retailer's Middle East footprint.

events.head: Haleon prices a $2B three-tranche bond to refinance 2027 maturities
events.sum: Haleon Capital priced $600M of 4.625% notes due 2029, $600M of 4.875% due 2031 and $800M of 5.375% due 2036, settling 21 August. Proceeds repurchase the 2027 notes tendered on 11 August and fund general corporate purposes.

events.head: Natura &Co profit plunges 92% in Q2 as Brazil pressure deepens
events.sum: Net income from continuing operations fell 92% year-on-year to R$35M (from R$446M) on a 9.1% consolidated revenue decline to R$5.17B, badly missing consensus. Brazil revenue dropped 14.8% to R$3.07B with the Natura brand down 14.5% and Avon down 22.5%, while Hispanic markets grew on a constant-currency basis.

events.head: Kenvue's beauty sales rise 5.1% as Neutrogena and OGX drive Q2 growth
events.sum: Kenvue's Skin Health and Beauty division posted 5.1% organic sales growth in Q2 2026, with 3.7% underlying organic growth split between 2.7 points of favourable value realisation and 1 point of volume. Neutrogena extended household-penetration gains for a third straight quarter in the US, with Hair Care and Face Care leading regional performance.

events.head: Ashland explores sale after takeover interest from PE firms
events.sum: Specialty ingredients supplier Ashland, valued around $3.5B, has engaged Citigroup and Lazard to explore a potential sale after inbound interest from Advent, Apollo and Carlyle, plus major shareholder Standard Industries. The process follows pressure from activist investor Ancora Holdings; a transaction is not certain.

events.head: APR's Q2 cosmetics revenue surges 185% on North America and Europe expansion
events.sum: South Korean beauty group APR (Medicube) posted Q2 revenue of KRW767.5B, up 134.2% year-on-year, with operating profit up 134.5% to KRW190.6B at a 24.8% margin. Cosmetics revenue jumped 185.5% to KRW648.3B, with North America up 264.6% and Europe up 380.3%; overseas sales now account for 92% of the total.

events.head: Fragrance brand Vyrao nears sale to undisclosed buyer
events.sum: British fragrance and wellness brand Vyrao, backed by Estée Lauder's New Incubation Ventures and L Catterton, is reportedly close to being acquired by an undisclosed buyer after five years of independent growth across the UK, US, Australia and Japan. Deal value and buyer identity remain unconfirmed.

events.head: PZ Cussons FY26 profit climbs as St.Tropez returns to North American growth
events.sum: PZ Cussons reported FY26 revenue of £541.4M, up 5.4% (5.8% like-for-like), with adjusted operating profit up 8.4% to £59.5M — up 24.5% excluding the divested PZ Wilmar joint venture. Self-tanning brand St.Tropez returned to growth in its key North American market, and each of the group's top ten brands grew during the year.

events.head: Haleon launches a tender offer for $1.999B of 2027 notes
events.sum: A cash tender for the outstanding 3.375% fixed-rate senior notes due March 2027, opening a refinancing of the group's near-term maturities.

events.head: Edgewell returns to organic growth as Q3 earnings beat expectations
events.sum: Edgewell Personal Care posted Q3 net sales of $570.1M, up 1.7%, with organic sales growth of 1.1% and adjusted EPS of $0.72 beating guidance. North America organic sales rose 3% on higher Sun Care, Skin Care and Grooming volumes, while international organic sales fell 1.4%.

events.head: Cymbiotika adds Alix Earle as investor in liposomal supplement brand
events.sum: Influencer Alix Earle has taken an undisclosed investment stake in Cymbiotika, joining a celebrity roster including Kendall Jenner, Hailey Bieber and The Weeknd. The bioactive supplement brand generated $150M in revenue last year and previously closed a $25M seed round in January 2026.

events.head: AKT London launches 'Final Encore' community crowdfunding round
events.sum: UK natural-deodorant brand AKT London opened a new community investment round, billed as its last raise of this kind, to let customers invest ahead of its next growth phase. Over 1,000 people pre-registered within 24 hours; the funding target was not disclosed.

events.head: Eurazeo to invest €410M in Aroma-Zone, taking control of French natural-beauty DTC
events.sum: Private equity firm Eurazeo has signed an exclusivity agreement to invest roughly €410M in Aroma-Zone, becoming the French natural beauty and aromatherapy retailer's main shareholder while the founding Vausselin family keeps a significant stake. Proceeds fund international expansion, the French e-commerce platform, and new stores beyond its current seven-store footprint.

events.head: Nu Skin Q2 2026 revenue drops 17%; impairments drive large GAAP loss
events.sum: Revenue fell 17.1% to $320.1M and impairment plus tax-valuation charges produced a $(5.14) GAAP loss per share ($0.20 adjusted); 2026 revenue guidance was cut to $1.28-$1.35B.

events.head: Lion H1 core operating income climbs 21% on oral care and overseas
events.sum: Lion's H1 2026 net sales rose 8.7% to ¥216.8B, core operating income 21.3% to ¥15.3B and operating profit 54.7% to ¥20.7B; full-year targets of ¥430B sales and ¥35B core operating income were kept.

events.head: Henkel H1 2026: 3.2% organic growth, full-year sales guidance raised
events.sum: First-half sales were €10,348M with 3.2% organic growth; Consumer Brands grew 1.7%, led by Hair at 4.2%. Henkel lifted its 2026 organic growth outlook to 1.5-3.5%.

events.head: Pola Orbis H1 2026 operating profit up 21%, full-year guidance kept
events.sum: H1 FY2026 net sales rose 1.3% to ¥84.3B, operating profit rose 21.1% to ¥9.95B and net profit rose 40.8% to ¥6.54B. FY2026 guidance was unchanged at sales of ¥173B and operating profit of ¥17.3B.

events.head: KOSÉ H1 operating profit drops 41.5% on Albion anniversary costs
events.sum: KOSÉ Holdings' H1 2026 net sales rose 2.7% to ¥164.9B but operating profit fell 41.5% to ¥6.6B, weighed by Albion 70th-anniversary spending and Cosmeport marketing; full-year guidance was held.

events.head: Kenvue reports second-quarter 2026 results
events.sum: Second-quarter results released before market open, with the Skin Health and Beauty division's organic growth the key datapoint ahead of the Kimberly-Clark close.

events.head: e.l.f. Beauty raises FY2027 outlook as Q1 net sales jump 36%
events.sum: Q1 fiscal 2027 net sales rose 36% to $479.4M against roughly $431M consensus, with adjusted net income of $104.6M (from $51.3M) and adjusted EPS of $1.75 versus $0.71 expected. Management lifted full-year FY27 guidance to 18-20% net sales growth from 12-14%, and to $1.93-1.96B in sales from $1.83-1.86B.

events.head: Unicharm H1 core operating income rises 14.1%
events.sum: Unicharm's H1 2026 net sales rose 4.9% to ¥487.1B and core operating income 14.1% to ¥65.0B; profit attributable to owners eased 1.9% to ¥41.0B.

events.head: Shiseido H1 operating profit climbs 132% as restructuring takes hold
events.sum: First-half net sales rose 6.2% to ¥499.0B with core operating profit up 90.1% to ¥44.4B and operating profit up 131.8% to ¥41.9B. China and Travel Retail sales rose 10.0% reported to ¥191.4B, with Clé de Peau Beauté and NARS driving the 618 festival.

events.head: Kao lifts 2026 outlook to ¥1.8T sales after strong first half
events.sum: Kao's H1 2026 net sales rose to ¥871.9B from ¥809.0B and operating income to ¥95.8B from ¥69.2B; it raised full-year guidance to ¥1.8T in sales and ¥135B in net income.

events.head: Beiersdorf guides to a full-year sales decline as Nivea drops 6.8%
events.sum: CEO Vincent Warnery said the group needs to acquire brands to dilute its reliance on Nivea after the flagship fell 6.8% in H1 2026. Beiersdorf now expects organic sales to decline in the low single digits for the full year.

events.head: LG H&H discontinues colour brand TIPSY as portfolio narrows to ten priorities
events.sum: LG Household & Health Care is winding down TIPSY, the colour cosmetics brand acquired via its 2020 majority stake in Roa Korea, after it failed to regain traction against social-first indie rivals. Investment shifts to ten priority brands including The History of Whoo, CNP, Belif and Dr. Groot under CEO Lee Sunjoo's restructuring. Terms undisclosed.

events.head: Bodycare secures Arāya Ventures-led investment for AI-powered retail rollout
events.sum: UK health-and-beauty retailer Bodycare raised an undisclosed round led by Arāya Ventures, joined by entrepreneur Dilesh Mehta and a syndicate of retail, technology and consumer-brand investors. Proceeds fund its AIMEE AI platform, new Studio Stores in Derby and Leicester, and creator-led commerce.

events.head: P&G to acquire supplements maker Thorne for $3.8B in premium wellness push
events.sum: P&G is buying Thorne in an all-cash $3.8B deal from LVMH-backed L Catterton, its largest step yet into premium wellness and personal health alongside Metamucil, Align and New Chapter. Thorne passed $500M revenue in 2025 and tracks toward roughly $650M this year, skewing under-40 and direct-to-consumer; the exit marks a more than $3B return for L Catterton, which took it private at $680M in 2023.

events.head: LG H&H Q2 operating profit up 87.5% as North America overtakes China
events.sum: Q2 consolidated revenue rose 3.3% to KRW1.6574tn with operating profit up 87.5% to KRW102.8B. North American revenue surged 47.3% to KRW205.8B, passing China's KRW176B for the first time, while overseas revenue grew 12.6% to KRW584.5B. The Beauty division returned to profit on 3.9% revenue growth.

events.head: Kimberly-Clark Q2 2026 sales up 0.6% as China campaign hits demand
events.sum: Net sales rose 0.6% to $4.19B with flat organic sales, hurt by a false social-media campaign in China; adjusted EPS from continuing operations rose 10.4% to $1.80.

events.head: Oriflame Q2 sales fall 13% as transformation programme grinds on
events.sum: Q2 sales dropped 13% in both euros and local currencies, with adjusted EBITDA swinging to a €4.7M loss on lower volumes, inventory provisions and excess-stock liquidation. Latin America grew 6% while Europe & CIS, Turkey & Africa and Asia all declined; adjusted cash flow before financing stayed positive at €8.6M.

events.head: Energizer Q3 FY26 sales up 1.2%; outlook moved to low end
events.sum: Net sales rose 1.2% to $734.1M (organic +2.7%) and adjusted EPS was $0.75; full-year adjusted EPS and EBITDA guidance moved to the low end of ranges.

events.head: Clorox Q4 FY26 sales dip 2%; guides to 13-14% sales growth in FY27
events.sum: Q4 net sales fell 2% to $1.95B (organic -13%, GOJO added ~10 pts) and adjusted EPS dropped 42% to $1.66; FY26 sales were $6.72B and FY27 adjusted EPS is guided to $5.70-$6.00.

events.head: Noevir nine-month operating income falls 13.9%
events.sum: Noevir's nine months to June 2026 net sales slipped 2.6% to ¥46.1B and operating income fell 13.9% to ¥6.9B; net income attributable was ¥4.1B (-0.8%).

events.head: Boots £7B takeover talks stall after Weston family lowers its offer
events.sum: Sycamore Partners rejected a reduced bid from the Weston family's Wittington Investments for Boots, leaving the roughly £7B ($9.4B) sale in doubt with a source close to talks putting revival at 50/50. The Westons cut their offer after Sigma Healthcare's June exit left them sole bidder; Sycamore is expected to restart IPO plans next year if no deal lands.

events.head: Beiersdorf cuts FY2026 guidance and resolves an 18-month NIVEA turnaround
events.sum: H1 group sales fell 3.5% organically to €5.0B with NIVEA down 6.8% on customer conflicts, delayed seasonal demand and trade destocking, while derma brands Eucerin and Aquaphor grew 7.8%. The board resolved an 18-month NIVEA turnaround with an additional €100M of consumer-facing marketing in H2 and now guides to a low-single-digit organic sales decline for the year.

events.head: Colgate Q2 2026 sales up 4.9%; Base Business EPS climbs 8%
events.sum: Net sales rose 4.9% to $5.36B with 2.4% organic growth; GAAP EPS fell to $0.86 while Base Business EPS rose 8% to $0.99.

events.head: Church & Dwight Q2 2026 organic growth of 5.8% beats outlook; guidance raised
events.sum: Net sales rose 1.6% to $1.53B with 5.8% organic growth; adjusted EPS was $0.89 and the full-year organic growth outlook was raised to 4-5%.

events.head: Reckitt H1 2026: net revenue $8.25B as Q2 growth accelerates
events.sum: Reckitt's first-half net revenue rose 1.8% to $8.25B, with like-for-like growth accelerating in the second quarter across all areas and categories. It kept its 2026 Core Reckitt LFL outlook of 4-5%.

events.head: L'Oréal H1 growth accelerates to 6.5% with a record 21.3% operating margin
events.sum: First-half sales of €23.7B, up 5.8% reported despite a 2.8-point currency headwind, with adjusted like-for-like growth of 6.5% — more than double H1 2025's 3.2% — and a first-half record operating margin of 21.3%.

events.head: Haleon H1 2026 revenue £5.60B, organic growth 2.6%
events.sum: First-half revenue rose 2.2% to £5.60B, in line with consensus, with 2.6% organic growth. Haleon had completed £457M of its £500M 2026 buyback.

events.head: Amorepacific Q2 operating profit surges 53% as overseas revenue jumps 28%
events.sum: Group revenue of KRW1.2543tn with operating profit up 53% to KRW122.8B. At the flagship Amorepacific unit overseas revenue rose 28% and overseas operating profit nearly doubled, up 99%, led by the Americas and EMEA.

events.head: Amorepacific Group Q2 operating profit jumps 53.3% on Americas and EMEA strength
events.sum: Group Q2 revenue rose 14.6% to KRW1.25tn with operating profit up 53.3% to KRW122.8B, beating consensus. Americas and EMEA revenue climbed 28% with operating profit up 99%, while Greater China declined on channel optimisation. The group held a double-digit operating margin for a second consecutive quarter.

events.head: P&G Beauty net sales rise 7% to $16.0B in fiscal 2026
events.sum: Fourth-quarter and full-year results: the Beauty division was among the group's strongest, with annual net sales up 7% to $16.0B on hair care and premium skincare including SK-II. Beauty organic sales rose 4% in Q4 after 7% in Q3.

events.head: Hermès H1 2026 revenue reaches €8.2B with 41% operating margin
events.sum: First-half revenue was €8.16B, up 6.1% at constant currency (1.6% reported); recurring operating income was €3.35B (41.0% margin) and net profit roughly flat at €2.24B.

events.head: Dabur Q1 FY27 revenue up 10.6% to Rs3,764 crore
events.sum: For the June 2026 quarter Dabur posted consolidated revenue from operations of Rs3,764.39 crore, up about 10.6% YoY, and net profit of Rs586.16 crore.

events.head: Unilever posts its best first half in a decade, Beauty & Wellbeing up 5.9%
events.sum: Group underlying sales grew 4.8% with volume contributing 4.2 points — the strongest volume-led first half in ten years. Beauty & Wellbeing rose 5.9% (4.5% volume), led by double-digit volume growth at Dove, Sunsilk and Vaseline plus prestige beauty.

events.head: LVMH H1 2026: Selective Retailing up 5% organic as Sephora gains share
events.sum: H1 2026 Selective Retailing revenue was €8.41B (+5% organic, -2% reported) and profit from recurring operations rose 2% to €893M. LVMH said Sephora grew strongly with Rhode and entered Belgium and Croatia.

events.head: LVMH Perfumes & Cosmetics holds flat at €3.9B as second-quarter growth accelerates
events.sum: Half-year revenue of €38.6B with organic growth of 2%, accelerating to 3% in Q2. Perfumes & Cosmetics was stable organically at €3.9B with a slightly higher operating margin, helped by Dior's J'adore Intense and Dior Addict launches, Guerlain and Maison Francis Kurkdjian.

events.head: Galderma H1 2026 net sales top $3B; guidance raised to 19-21%
events.sum: First-half net sales were a record $3,134M, up 24.6% at constant currency, with a 25.6% Core EBITDA margin. Galderma raised full-year growth guidance to 19-21% from 17-20%.

events.head: Amorepacific to sell regional offices and logistics centres to fund overseas push
events.sum: Amorepacific is divesting domestic property — regional offices in Busan, Daegu, Daejeon and Gwangju plus logistics centres in Incheon and Gimhae — targeting roughly KRW150B (~$109M) to redirect capital toward its goal of 70% overseas revenue and KRW15tn sales by 2035. A group-level asset-efficiency programme, not a brand sale.

events.head: Amorepacific to sell Anseong inner-beauty plant, consolidate output at Osan
events.sum: Amorepacific is seeking a buyer for its Anseong health-supplement plant (KRW204.7B annual capacity, ~46% utilisation last year), which makes its Vital Beauty inner-beauty line, shifting production to its larger Osan complex to lift capital efficiency. Sale price undisclosed.

events.head: LG H&H launches auction for beverage unit Haitai HTB as K-beauty majors refocus
events.sum: LG H&H is running preliminary auctions for Haitai HTB, Korea's third-largest beverage company (~KRW343B annual sales), to concentrate on cosmetics as indie K-beauty brands gain share — paralleling Amorepacific's own asset disposals. Price undisclosed; intent letters expected this month.

events.head: First US-listed K-beauty ETF filed with the SEC
events.sum: US asset manager Guinness Atkinson filed a preliminary prospectus for the K-Beauty ETF (KBTY), set for NYSE Arca in H2 — at least 80% in South Korean beauty names spanning brand owners, contract manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, retailers and dermatology. A first dedicated public-markets vehicle for the sector.

events.head: Avon signs lease at The Rowe for a consolidated London headquarters
events.sum: Avon took 15,234 sq ft of fitted office space at Frasers Property UK's Whitechapel development, folding its London teams into a single site. Lease value undisclosed — a footprint decision rather than a capital commitment.

events.head: Frasers Group forces its way into the Harvey Nichols sale process
events.sum: A memo to suppliers said Harvey Nichols is now obliged to admit Frasers alongside other bidders including Next, with initial bids expected later in July. Reported via Sky News, not an official announcement; several brand owners have raised concerns over the luxury positioning of the beauty halls.
events.date_verification: Article byline '15 July 2026 by Camilla Rydzek'; underlying supplier memo sent Tuesday 14 July

events.head: Prenetics' IM8 secures $1B growth financing from General Catalyst
events.sum: General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund will finance up to 70% of IM8's marketing spend in return for a capped share of revenue — structured as a loan, not venture equity. The Beckham-co-founded supplement brand reported ~$17M revenue in June and projects a $300M run-rate by year-end.

events.head: Shein secures CSRC approval for a Hong Kong IPO
events.sum: China's securities regulator has cleared Shein to proceed with a Hong Kong listing — a capital-markets and distribution-scale event for the K-beauty houses that reach shoppers through its cross-border marketplace.

events.head: US appeals court revives Tylenol autism suits, clouding the $48.7B Kimberly-Clark deal
events.sum: The Second Circuit reinstated more than 500 private claims tying prenatal Tylenol use to autism and ADHD, ruling expert testimony had been improperly excluded. Kenvue shares fell about 2%, adding litigation risk to the pending Kimberly-Clark acquisition.

events.head: Rituals commits €40M to refresh 1,500 boutiques across 30 countries
events.sum: A retail-capital programme beginning 3 August, with the first European phase completing 25 September — continued investment in prestige body and home ranges after 2025 revenue of €2.43B, up 15.7%.

events.head: Megan Thee Stallion's Coty fragrance reaches Ulta stores nationwide
events.sum: Hot Girl Summer Eau de Parfum ($29–$84) reached Ulta shelves on 11 July — the retail rollout of the Coty celebrity-fragrance partnership announced 2 July.

events.head: Style Capital takes a minority stake in Essential Parfums
events.sum: The Italian private-equity fund backs the Parisian clean-fragrance house — continued institutional appetite for indie perfume in the prestige tier.

events.head: L'Oréal secures a 50-year exclusive worldwide beauty licence for Gucci
events.sum: Kering and L'Oréal brought the Gucci beauty licence forward by a year. L'Oréal takes over creation, development and distribution of Gucci fragrance and beauty from 1 July 2027, subject to regulatory approvals — an extension of the October 2025 alliance.

events.head: Coty agrees to hand the Gucci Beauty licence back to Kering for about $400M
events.sum: Coty receives roughly $400M to transition the Gucci Beauty licence early, and will continue operating the brand through at least 30 June 2027. The exit removes a major franchise from Coty's prestige portfolio.

events.head: Henkel closes its acquisition of Olaplex
events.sum: The $1.4B purchase of the prestige hair care brand completed, bringing Olaplex into Henkel's Consumer Brands hair portfolio alongside Schwarzkopf.

events.head: Suzano completes purchase of 51% of Kimberly-Clark's international tissue business
events.sum: Suzano closed its acquisition of a 51% stake in the IFP tissue joint venture (to be renamed Arbex), paying about $1.3B subject to adjustments; Kimberly-Clark keeps 49%.

events.head: L'Oréal takes a majority stake in Indian personal care house Innovist
events.sum: A majority investment in Innovist, the house behind several fast-growing Indian personal care brands, marking a significant step up in L'Oréal's exposure to India's expanding beauty market. Terms undisclosed.

events.head: Jay-Z's MarcyPen said to be in talks for LVMH's Fenty Beauty stake
events.sum: MarcyPen Capital Partners is reportedly negotiating to buy LVMH's 50% Fenty Beauty holding (held via Kendo) and has explored financing structures with outside investors; no price disclosed.

events.head: Ulta Beauty Q1 net sales rise 11.1% to $3.2B as comps gain 5.3%
events.sum: First-quarter net sales grew 11.1% to $3.2B with comparable sales up 5.3% — a 3.7% higher average ticket and 1.6% more transactions — and the company updated its fiscal 2026 guidance.

events.head: Oddity Q1 2026 revenue falls 26% and swings to a loss
events.sum: Q1 2026 net revenue fell to $197.9M from $268.1M, with a net loss of $21.4M and adjusted EBITDA of -$7.0M. Q2 revenue was guided down 25-30% with adjusted EBITDA of $8-10M; the company has $350M of undrawn credit facilities.

events.head: Church & Dwight acquires stain-removal brand Miss Mouth's Messy Eater for about $325M
events.sum: A bolt-on that extends the household and personal-care portfolio into specialist stain removal, at a price of roughly $325M.

events.head: Proya to take control of color cosmetics brand Flower Knows
events.sum: Proya's Hainan unit will pay RMB351M for about 12.55% of Flower Knows, lifting its stake from 38.45% to 51% and consolidating the brand.

events.head: Estée Lauder and Puig terminate combination discussions
events.sum: The parties ended talks over a potential business combination, closing the door on what would have been a roughly $40B luxury beauty group and leaving Estée Lauder to pursue its turnaround independently.

events.head: Chanel returns to growth with 2025 revenue of $19.3B
events.sum: Chanel's 2025 revenue rose 2% to $19.3B and operating profit climbed 5% to $4.7B.

events.head: LVMH reported to weigh sale of its 50% Fenty Beauty stake
events.sum: Citing the FT, the report says LVMH is exploring the sale of its Fenty Beauty stake, valued by JPMorgan at €1.5–2.5B, within a wider review that also covers Make Up For Ever and Fresh; LVMH declined comment.

events.head: Estée Lauder plans to divest Too Faced, Smashbox and Dr.Jart+
events.sum: Three brands go up for sale as the portfolio narrows around the highest-return franchises — the colour houses Too Faced and Smashbox plus Korean skincare brand Dr.Jart+. Terms were not disclosed.

events.head: KOSÉ Q1 operating profit plunges 85% to ¥1.0B
events.sum: KOSÉ Holdings' Q1 2026 net sales slipped 0.9% to ¥78.3B while operating profit fell 84.5% to ¥1.03B and net profit 91.9% to ¥0.43B.

events.head: Noevir H1 operating income down 20.6%
events.sum: Noevir's six months to March 2026 net sales fell 4.4% to ¥30.6B and operating income 20.6% to ¥4.5B; net income attributable rose 2.9% to ¥2.7B.

events.head: Kao Q1 operating profit jumps 45% on land-sale gain and cosmetics recovery
events.sum: Kao's first-quarter 2026 net sales rose 6.0% to ¥413.2B and operating income rose 45.3% to ¥44.9B, including an ¥11.5B land-sale gain; full-year guidance of ¥1.75T sales and ¥130B net profit was kept.

events.head: Clorox raises $1.5B in senior notes to refinance GOJO funding
events.sum: Clorox sold $1.5B of notes due 2031, 2033 and 2036 (4.70%-5.25%), priced May 6 and closed May 11, to repay a $1.25B term loan and commercial paper used for the GOJO deal.

events.head: Shiseido Q1 2026 core operating profit jumps 58% despite a China slowdown
events.sum: First-quarter core operating profit rose sharply on restructuring benefits, with the Americas turning profitable and the China outlook revised upward even as revenue declined.

events.head: Lion Q1 sales up 5.3%, operating profit up 11.6%
events.sum: Lion's Q1 2026 net sales rose 5.3% to ¥99.2B and operating profit 11.6% to ¥6.3B; profit attributable to owners rose 4.5% to ¥4.2B.

events.head: Pola Orbis Q1 2026 operating profit up 18.7%
events.sum: Q1 FY2026 net sales fell 1.2% to ¥40.8B while operating profit rose 18.7% to ¥4.93B; ordinary profit jumped 153% to ¥6.26B and net profit rose 88% to ¥2.46B.

events.head: Unicharm Q1 core operating income up 8.5%
events.sum: Unicharm's Q1 2026 net sales rose 2.9% to ¥234.2B and core operating income 8.5% to ¥31.5B, but profit attributable to owners fell 20.7% to ¥19.8B.

events.head: Dabur Q4 FY26 profit up 16% to Rs362 crore; Rs5.50 final dividend
events.sum: March-quarter consolidated net profit rose 15.8% YoY to Rs362 crore on revenue from operations of Rs3,038 crore (+7.3%); the board recommended a Rs5.50 final dividend.

events.head: Henkel Q1 2026 sales €4.95B, organic growth 1.7%
events.sum: First-quarter sales were €4,952M, down 5.5% nominally, with 1.7% organic growth; Consumer Brands grew 1.8% organically to €2,285M. Henkel noted five announced deals worth about €1.6B in sales.

events.head: Nu Skin Q1 2026 revenue down 12%; BeautyBio wound down
events.sum: Revenue fell 12.0% to $320.6M; GAAP EPS was $0.04 and adjusted EPS $0.14, excluding costs of winding down the BeautyBio business.

events.head: Kenvue reports first-quarter 2026 results
events.sum: First-quarter results published before market open, again without a call given the pending Kimberly-Clark deal. Skin Health and Beauty remained the segment investors watched most closely.

events.head: Energizer Q2 FY26 sales fall 3% but tariff refund lifts margins
events.sum: Net sales declined 3.0% to $643.3M (organic about -5.5%); adjusted EPS was $0.94 including an expected IEEPA tariff refund, with EPS now seen at the high end of guidance.

events.head: Coty reports third-quarter fiscal 2026 results
events.sum: Results for the quarter ended 31 March 2026, with the Consumer Beauty strategic review — covering CoverGirl, Rimmel, Sally Hansen and Max Factor — still running alongside the prestige fragrance business.

events.head: Estée Lauder lifts annual profit forecast while cutting up to 3,000 more jobs
events.sum: The company raised its full-year profit outlook and widened its restructuring, now targeting a reduction of 9,000 to 10,000 positions against a prior ceiling of 7,000, as CEO Stéphane de La Faverie pushes the turnaround toward profitability.

events.head: Colgate Q1 2026 sales up 8.4% on currency and pricing
events.sum: Net sales rose 8.4% to $5.32B with organic growth of 2.9%; GAAP EPS fell 6% to $0.80 while Base Business EPS rose 7% to $0.97.

events.head: Church & Dwight Q1 2026 organic sales up 5%
events.sum: Net sales edged up 0.2% to $1.469B as organic sales grew 5.0% on volume; adjusted EPS rose 4.4% to $0.95, beating its outlook.

events.head: Clorox Q3 FY26 sales flat; guidance cut as GOJO is folded in
events.sum: Net sales were flat at $1.67B (organic -1%) and adjusted EPS rose 13% to $1.64, but full-year adjusted EPS guidance was lowered to $5.45-$5.65.

events.head: Unilever Q1 2026 underlying sales up 3.8%, Beauty & Wellbeing up 3.6%
events.sum: Group underlying sales growth of 3.8% with 2.9% from volume. Beauty & Wellbeing grew 3.6% — 1.9% volume, 1.6% price — on double-digit volume-led growth at Dove and Vaseline plus the prestige portfolio.

events.head: Haleon Q1 2026 organic sales up 2.2% as weak cold and flu season weighs
events.sum: Haleon's first-quarter organic sales rose 2.2% (price +2.4%, volume -0.2%), slightly below the 2.3% expected. It kept 2026 guidance of 3-5% organic revenue growth.

events.head: Amorepacific Group posts Q1 2026 revenue of KRW1.227tn
events.sum: First-quarter consolidated revenue of KRW1.227tn with operating profit of KRW137.8B, as overseas momentum in the Americas and EMEA continued to offset softness at home.

events.head: Kimberly-Clark Q1 2026 sales up 2.7%, outlook reaffirmed
events.sum: Net sales rose 2.7% to $4.2B with 2.5% organic growth; adjusted EPS was $1.97, up 2.1%, as the company prepares for the Kenvue deal.

events.head: Proya Q1 2026 revenue slips 2.3%, profit down 6%
events.sum: Q1 2026 revenue was RMB2.305B, down 2.29% YoY, and attributable net profit fell 6.05% to RMB367M.

events.head: Shanghai Jahwa Q1 2026 revenue up 5.4%
events.sum: Q1 2026 revenue was RMB1.795B, up 5.38% YoY, and attributable net profit rose 2.30% to RMB222M.

events.head: Proya posts first annual revenue and profit decline since listing
events.sum: 2025 revenue was RMB10.60B, down 1.68% YoY, and attributable net profit fell 3.5% to RMB1.50B, with the flagship Proya brand down about 10%.

events.head: Galderma Q1 2026 net sales $1.47B, up 25.5%
events.sum: First-quarter net sales were $1,473M, up 25.5% at constant currency, driven by Nemluvio's ramp-up and dermatological skincare. Guidance of 17-20% growth was confirmed.

events.head: Sephora China adds 11 Chinese beauty brands including Florasis and Judydoll
events.sum: Sephora China brought in 11 domestic brands, among them Florasis, Perfect Diary and JOY GROUP's Judydoll, across a network of 320 stores in 104 cities in Greater China.

events.head: Reckitt Q1 2026 net revenue £3.25B; Core Reckitt up 1.3% LFL
events.sum: First-quarter group net revenue was £3,247M, down 11.8% reported after the Essential Home disposal and FX, with group LFL growth of 0.6%. Core Reckitt grew 1.3% LFL, or 3.1% excluding seasonal OTC.

events.head: L'Oréal Q1 2026 sales rise 7.6% like-for-like to €12.15B
events.sum: First-quarter sales of €12.15B, up 3.6% reported and 7.6% like-for-like, with adjusted like-for-like growth of 6.7% — comfortably ahead of the global beauty market.

events.head: Hermès Q1 2026 sales rise 6% at constant currency despite €290M FX drag
events.sum: First-quarter revenue reached about €4.07B, up 6% at constant exchange rates but down 1% reported; the Americas grew 17% while the Middle East region fell 6%; perfume and beauty was flat.

events.head: Pierre Fabre 2025 revenue grows 4.6% to €3.2B
events.sum: Pierre Fabre's 2025 revenue rose 4.6% at constant currency to about €3.2B; dermo-cosmetics and personal care grew 3.9% to €1.7B (55% of sales) while pharma rose 5.5% to €1.4B.

events.head: LVMH Q1 2026: Selective Retailing up 4% organically on Sephora
events.sum: Selective Retailing revenue was €4.05B in Q1 2026, +4% organic (about -3% reported), outperforming the group's +1%, with Sephora's expansion, including in the UK, the key driver.

events.head: Grupo Boticário consumer sales reach R$38.1B in 2025, up 6.7%
events.sum: Grupo Boticário's 2025 GMV (sell-out to consumers) rose 6.7% to R$38.1B from R$35.7B in 2024; net revenue and profit were not disclosed in the article.

events.head: LVMH Q1 2026 revenue €19.1B, up 1% organically; beauty stable
events.sum: First-quarter revenue was €19.12B, down 6% reported with a 7-point currency hit but up 1% organically; Perfumes & Cosmetics booked €2.04B, flat organically.

events.head: L'Oréal closes €4B purchase of Kering Beauté and House of Creed
events.sum: After antitrust clearance, L'Oréal completed its €4B cash acquisition of Kering Beauté, including Creed, plus 50-year Bottega Veneta and Balenciaga beauty licences; its largest deal ever.

events.head: Clorox completes the GOJO acquisition, forming Clorox Purell
events.sum: The $2.25B purchase closed and now operates as Clorox Purell, adding the Purell franchise and GOJO's health and hygiene solutions to the portfolio.

events.head: Amway posts $7.3B in 2025 global sales, slightly below prior year
events.sum: Amway reported $7.3B in global sales for the year ended Dec 31, 2025, modestly lower than 2024's $7.4B; its beauty category grew 8% globally.

events.head: Henkel to acquire Olaplex for $1.4B in a pivot to premium hair care
events.sum: An all-cash offer of $2.06 per share for the bond-building hair care pioneer, a roughly 55% premium to the prior close of $1.33. The deal anchors Henkel's move up-market in professional and prestige hair.

events.head: JOY GROUP 2025 revenue tops US$620M, up 22%
events.sum: JOY GROUP reported 2025 revenue above US$620M (RMB4.3B), up 22% YoY, on retail sales over US$730M, with JUDYDOLL retail sales above US$430M.
events.src: PR Newswire via Kyodo News PR Wire

events.head: Shanghai Jahwa returns to profit in 2025 as revenue rises 11%
events.sum: 2025 revenue rose 11.2% to about RMB6.32B and attributable net profit was about RMB270M, a turnaround from a loss in 2024.

events.head: Estée Lauder confirms merger discussions with Puig
events.sum: The two confirmed talks over a potential business combination that analysts valued at more than $40B, which would have brought Clinique, MAC and Tom Ford together with Rabanne and Jean Paul Gaultier. No agreement was reached.

events.head: Revlon wins SALT LIFE fragrance licence and renews ED HARDY with Iconix
events.sum: Iconix granted Revlon a long-term global licence to launch the first SALT LIFE fragrance in 2027, and Revlon renewed its ED HARDY fragrance licence.

events.head: L'Oréal widens NVIDIA alliance into AI-driven formulation R&D
events.sum: L'Oréal extended its NVIDIA collaboration from marketing into research, applying NVIDIA's ALCHEMI framework to predict molecular behaviour, initially for photoprotection and skin tone; no financial terms disclosed.

events.head: Ulta Beauty posts Q4 and fiscal 2025 results, guides to 6–7% growth in fiscal 2026
events.sum: Fourth-quarter results for the period ended 31 January 2026, alongside fiscal 2026 guidance of 6.0–7.0% net sales growth, 2.5–3.5% comparable sales growth and 9.4–11.4% diluted EPS growth.

events.head: Oddity authorizes $200M share buyback
events.sum: The board approved repurchases of up to $200M of Class A shares, running to March 31, 2029 and replacing the prior $150M plan. By the Q2 2026 report the company had bought back about $163M of shares year to date.

events.head: Henkel FY2025 sales €20.5B with 0.9% organic growth; guides 1-3% for 2026
events.sum: Henkel's 2025 sales were €20.5B with organic growth of 0.9%, and Q4 organic growth of 2.3% missed expectations. For 2026 it guided to 1-3% organic growth, with 0.5-2.5% in Consumer Brands.

events.head: EQT-led consortium exits Galderma; company buys back CHF 232M of shares
events.sum: EQT, ADIA and Auba sold their remaining Galderma shares through an accelerated bookbuild, ending the founding consortium's stake. Galderma bought back 1.6M shares at CHF 143.75 each, totalling CHF 232M.

events.head: Galderma places €500M five-year Eurobond
events.sum: Galderma issued a single-tranche €500M Eurobond with a five-year term and a 3.375% annual fixed coupon.

events.head: Henkel to buy US hair brand Not Your Mother's from Main Post Partners
events.sum: Henkel agreed to acquire Not Your Mother's, a US hair care and styling brand with about €190M in 2025 sales, from private equity firm Main Post Partners. Terms were not disclosed; the deal closed by early May 2026.

events.head: Reckitt FY2025 like-for-like revenue up 5.2%, Q4 up 5.4%
events.sum: Reckitt reported full-year like-for-like revenue growth of 5.2%, with fourth-quarter LFL growth of 5.4%, and guided to 4-5% Core Reckitt LFL growth in 2026. It returned £2.3B to shareholders during the year.

events.head: Galderma posts record 2025 net sales of $5.21B, up 17.7%
events.sum: Galderma's 2025 net sales reached $5,207M, up 17.7% at constant currency, with Core EBITDA of $1,211M (23.3% margin). It guided to 17-20% constant-currency growth for 2026.

events.head: Dabur takes minority stake in luxury skincare D2C brand RAS Beauty
events.sum: In the first deal from Dabur Ventures, Dabur signed a definitive agreement to buy a minority stake in Raipur-based RAS Beauty for about Rs60 crore; stake percentage not disclosed.

events.head: Kalon Holdings' tender offer for Mandom succeeds, taking majority control
events.sum: Kalon Holdings' MBO tender offer closed Feb 25 with 32.36M shares tendered, above the 25.29M minimum, giving it over 50% of votes from March 4; at ¥3,105 a share the tendered stake is worth about ¥100B. Mandom was subsequently delisted on May 15, 2026.

events.head: Haleon FY2025 organic revenue up 3% to £11.0B; £500M buyback set for 2026
events.sum: Haleon's 2025 revenue was £11.0B with 3.0% organic growth (2.3% price, 0.7% volume/mix), below its 4-6% medium-term range. It allocated £500M to buybacks in 2026.

events.head: Oddity reports record FY2025 revenue of $810M and warns of a Q1 2026 drop
events.sum: Q4 2025 net revenue rose 24% to $153M and FY2025 revenue rose 25% to $810M, with FY adjusted EBITDA of $163M and net income of $110.7M. Citing a dislocation in customer acquisition costs at its largest ad partner, the company guided Q1 2026 revenue down about 30% year on year.

events.head: Kenvue reports fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results
events.sum: Full-year results released without a conference call because of the pending Kimberly-Clark transaction, with Skin Health and Beauty — Neutrogena, Aveeno, OGX — the segment under closest scrutiny ahead of the merger.

events.head: Pola Orbis FY2025 operating profit up 13.6% on flat sales; voluntary retirement at POLA
events.sum: FY2025 net sales were flat at ¥170.3B and operating profit rose 13.6% to ¥15.7B on Orbis gains and smaller Jurlique losses; net profit rose 2.0% to ¥9.47B. FY2026 guidance is sales of ¥173B and operating profit of ¥17.3B, and POLA will offer voluntary retirement to about 160 staff (about ¥1.4B special loss).

events.head: Unilever FY2025: 3.5% underlying sales growth, Beauty & Wellbeing up 4.3%, new €1.5B buyback
events.sum: Full-year 2025 turnover was €50.5B, down 3.8% on currency, with underlying sales growth of 3.5% and Beauty & Wellbeing up 4.3%. Unilever also announced a buyback of up to €1.5B starting in Q2 2026.

events.head: Unicharm FY2025 sales slip 4.4%, core operating income falls 21%
events.sum: Unicharm's 2025 net sales fell 4.4% to ¥945.3B and core operating income 21.4% to ¥108.9B; profit attributable to owners declined 20.3% to ¥65.2B.

events.head: L'Oréal 2025 sales reach €44.05B with record 20.2% operating margin
events.sum: 2025 sales grew 4.0% like-for-like (1.3% reported) to €44.05B; operating margin rose 20bps to 20.2%, EPS before one-offs was €12.71 and a €7.20 dividend was proposed.

events.head: Hermès 2025 revenue hits €16B as margin climbs to 41%
events.sum: Hermès posted 2025 revenue of €16.0B, up 8.9% at constant currency (5.5% reported), with recurring operating income of €6.57B (41.0% margin) and group net profit of €4.52B after France's exceptional levy.

events.head: Nu Skin 2025 revenue falls 14% to $1.49B
events.sum: Q4 revenue dropped 16.9% to $370.3M with EPS of $0.29; full-year revenue was $1.49B and 2026 guidance is $1.35-$1.50B.

events.head: Lion FY2025 core operating income rises 16.8% to ¥30.8B
events.sum: Lion's 2025 net sales grew 2.2% to ¥422.1B, operating profit rose 28.1% to ¥36.4B and core operating income 16.8% to ¥30.8B; profit attributable to owners climbed 30.1% to ¥27.6B.

events.head: KOSÉ Holdings FY2025 profit doubles; targets ¥350B sales in 2026
events.sum: KOSÉ Holdings' 2025 net sales rose 2.3% to about ¥330B and operating profit 6.3% to ¥18.4B, while net profit attributable doubled (+101.2%) to ¥15.1B. It guided to 2026 sales of ¥350B and operating profit of ¥20B.

events.head: KOSÉ Holdings authorises ¥3B share buyback
events.sum: KOSÉ Holdings approved repurchasing up to 650,000 shares (1.14% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) for up to ¥3B through April 20, 2026, to lift capital efficiency and shareholder returns.

events.head: Kalon Holdings raises Mandom MBO tender price to ¥3,105; board backs bid
events.sum: Kalon Holdings lifted its tender offer price for Mandom shares to ¥3,105 under a binding proposal, and Mandom's board resolved to support the offer and recommend shareholders tender.

events.head: Kao FY2025 operating income up 11.9% to ¥164.1B; guides to ¥182B for 2026
events.sum: Kao's 2025 net sales rose 3.7% to ¥1,688.6B and operating income climbed 11.9% to ¥164.1B, with net income up 11.4% to ¥120.1B; it forecast 2026 sales of ¥1.75T and operating income of ¥182B.

events.head: Amorepacific Group 2025 operating profit jumps 47.6% to KRW368bn
events.sum: Amorepacific Holdings' 2025 revenue rose 8.5% to KRW4.623tn and operating profit 47.6% to KRW368bn, the highest since 2019; Q4 revenue rose 6% to KRW1.255tn while operating profit fell 31% to KRW54.8bn on voluntary-retirement costs.

events.head: Mandom nine-month operating income more than doubles
events.sum: Mandom's April-December 2025 net sales rose 3.6% to ¥59.2B and operating income 116.4% to ¥2.9B; net income attributable rose 16.6% to ¥2.1B.

events.head: Cosnova posts record 2025 revenue of €991M
events.sum: 2025 net revenue rose about 4% to a record €991M, with e-commerce up about 20%. Cosnova also bought its Barcelona distributor and is taking over its Eastern European distributor, which covers 11 South-Eastern European countries.

events.head: Noevir Q1 operating income falls 29%
events.sum: Noevir's October-December 2025 net sales fell 7.9% to ¥15.5B and operating income 29.0% to ¥2.3B, though net income attributable rose 35.7% to ¥1.3B.

events.head: Estée Lauder reports fiscal 2026 second-quarter results
events.sum: Second-quarter results under the turnaround plan, with fragrance the standout and Mainland China outperforming prestige beauty to gain share. Management held to its profit-recovery trajectory.

events.head: Energizer Q1 FY26 sales up 6.5% on APS deal; tariffs squeeze profit
events.sum: Net sales rose 6.5% to $778.9M with $64.6M from the APS acquisition; adjusted EPS fell to $0.31 and the full-year outlook was reaffirmed.

events.head: Coty reports second-quarter fiscal 2026 results
events.sum: Results for the quarter ended 31 December 2025, with prestige fragrance carrying the group while Consumer Beauty stayed under review following the strategic assessment of the mass colour portfolio.

events.head: Clorox Q2 FY26 sales slip 1%, outlook reaffirmed
events.sum: Net sales eased 1% to $1.67B with organic sales also down 1%; adjusted EPS fell 10% to $1.39 and full-year guidance was confirmed.

events.head: Clorox agrees to buy P&G's 20% stake in Glad joint venture for $476M
events.sum: On the venture's expiry Clorox agreed to purchase Procter & Gamble's 20% interest in the Glad bags and wraps business for $476M in cash.

events.head: Colgate 2025 sales hit $20.4B; skin health impairment pushes Q4 to GAAP loss
events.sum: Q4 net sales grew 5.8% to $5.23B (organic +2.2%) with Base Business EPS of $0.95, but skin-health impairments caused a GAAP loss; full-year sales were $20.38B.

events.head: Church & Dwight 2025 sales reach $6.2B; Q4 organic growth only 0.7%
events.sum: Q4 net sales rose 3.9% but organic growth was 0.7%; full-year sales grew 1.6% to $6.20B with adjusted EPS of $3.53, and 2026 guidance calls for 3-4% organic growth.

events.head: Cosnova acquires Spain's Niche Beauty Lab to enter skincare
events.sum: Cosnova, owner of essence and Catrice, bought Barcelona-based Niche Beauty Lab (Acnemy, Theramid, Transparent Lab), its first move into skincare. Founder-CEO Sergio Chorrero stays on and terms were not disclosed.

events.head: Dabur Q3 FY26 net profit rises 7.3% to Rs553.6 crore
events.sum: Consolidated net profit for the December 2025 quarter was Rs553.61 crore, up 7.3% YoY, on revenue from operations of Rs3,558.65 crore, up 6.1%.

events.head: Kimberly-Clark and Kenvue shareholders overwhelmingly approve the acquisition
events.sum: Both sets of stockholders passed every proposal needed to complete the $48.7B combination at their respective special meetings, clearing the principal shareholder hurdle ahead of a targeted second-half 2026 close.

events.head: LVMH 2025 revenue slips to €80.8B; beauty flat but profit up 8%
events.sum: Group 2025 revenue fell 5% reported (−1% organic) to €80.8B and recurring operating profit dropped 9% to €17.75B; Perfumes & Cosmetics was flat organically at about €8.17B with profit up 8%.

events.head: LVMH FY2025: Sephora drives 28% profit jump in Selective Retailing
events.sum: Selective Retailing revenue was €18.35B (+4% organic) and profit from recurring operations rose 28% to €1.78B, a 9.7% margin. LVMH cited a remarkable performance by Sephora, with growth in revenue and profit, market share gains and about 100 store openings in 2025.

events.head: Kimberly-Clark Q4 2025 adjusted EPS jumps 24%
events.sum: Q4 net sales slipped 0.6% to $4.1B while organic sales grew 2.1%; adjusted EPS rose 24% to $1.86 and 2025 sales from continuing operations were $16.4B.

events.head: Clorox to acquire Purell maker GOJO Industries for $2.25B
events.sum: An all-cash definitive agreement for the skin-health and hygiene leader behind Purell. The $2.25B headline includes roughly $330M of anticipated tax benefits, for a net purchase price near $1.92B.

events.head: Sephora and CJ Olive Young form global K-beauty omnichannel partnership
events.sum: Olive Young will curate K-beauty zones in Sephora stores and online, starting in autumn 2026 in the US, Canada, Hong Kong SAR, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand, then the Middle East, UK and Australia in 2027. The US launch on Aug 20 2026 covered 19 brands in more than 500 stores.

events.head: Reckitt completes Essential Home sale to Advent, confirms £1.6B special dividend
events.sum: Reckitt closed the sale of its Essential Home unit to Advent on 31 December 2025 (a deal valued at up to $4.8B when announced), keeping a 30% stake in the buyer vehicle. It confirmed a special dividend of about £1.6B (235p a share).

events.head: L'Oréal prices €1.75B triple-tranche bond, partly to fund Galderma stake
events.sum: L'Oréal sold €1.75B of bonds in 2-year floating, 3-year (2.5%) and 6-year (2.875%) tranches; proceeds go to general purposes including part of the extra 10% Galderma stake.

events.head: Rare Beauty expands beyond Sephora with Ulta Beauty rollout
events.sum: Rare Beauty said it would launch across Ulta Beauty's 1,500+ US stores and ulta.com from Feb 1, 2026, its first retail expansion since its 2020 debut, with two Ulta-exclusive kits and a joint charity donation drive.

events.head: Coty sells its remaining 25.8% Wella stake to KKR for $750M upfront
events.sum: Coty sold its remaining 25.8% stake in Wella to KKR affiliates for $750M in upfront cash, plus 45% of proceeds from a later sale or IPO once KKR's preferred return is met.

events.head: Yves Rocher enters India through Nykaa partnership
events.sum: Groupe Rocher's Yves Rocher signed a strategic deal with Nykaa to sell about 100 hair and facial care products across Nykaa's app, site and stores from June 2026, part of a four-year EUR100M international growth plan.

events.head: Church & Dwight to sell VitaFusion and L'il Critters to Piping Rock
events.sum: The company agreed to divest its gummy-vitamin brands and Washington-state facilities to Piping Rock Health Products after a review of the VMS unit, which is under 5% of sales; terms were not disclosed.

events.head: L'Oréal doubles Galderma stake to 20% to deepen its aesthetics play
events.sum: L'Oréal buys a further 10% of the Swiss dermatology group from the EQT-led consortium including the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, taking its holding to 20%. Terms undisclosed; closing expected in Q1 2026, with two L'Oréal board candidates replacing consortium representatives at the 2026 AGM.

events.head: Grupo Boticário raises R$2B in ESG-linked debentures
events.sum: Boticário launched a R$2B three-series debenture issue via subsidiary Cálamo, led by Itaú BBA; two series are sustainability-linked and one falls under the Eco Invest Brasil program, with proceeds refinancing earlier debt and funding green projects.

events.head: Oddity posts record Q3 2025 and lifts full-year outlook
events.sum: Q3 2025 net revenue rose 24% to $148M, with net income of $18M and adjusted EBITDA up 16% to $29M. FY2025 revenue guidance was raised to $806-809M and adjusted EBITDA guidance to $161-163M.

events.head: Energizer Q4 FY25 sales rise 3.4%; FY26 EPS guided to $3.30-$3.60
events.sum: Q4 net sales rose 3.4% to $832.8M helped by acquisitions (organic -2.2%) and adjusted EPS was $1.05; fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS is guided to $3.30-$3.60.

events.head: Revlon signs global fragrance license for Champion
events.sum: Revlon agreed with Authentic Brands Group to develop Champion's first fragrance collection for a 2027 global launch, its second licence with Authentic that year.

events.head: Kosé nine-month operating profit falls 27.8% as SG&A climbs
events.sum: Kosé's nine-month 2025 net sales edged up 0.7% (to ¥240.5B per a companion TipRanks note) while operating profit fell 27.8% and ordinary profit 34.5% on higher SG&A; it held its full-year sales growth target of 4.1%.

events.head: Unicharm nine-month core operating income down 16.4%
events.sum: Unicharm's nine-month 2025 net sales fell 3.9% to ¥694.2B and core operating income 16.4% to ¥86.6B, while profit attributable to owners rose 2.0% to ¥60.7B.

events.head: Pola Orbis reports nine-month 2025 results
events.sum: For January-September 2025, net sales were ¥125.0B, operating profit ¥11.95B, ordinary profit ¥11.22B (-4.3% YoY) and net profit ¥7.65B.

events.head: Noevir FY2025 sales up 1.4%, operating income down 3%
events.sum: Noevir Holdings' fiscal year to September 2025 net sales rose 1.4% to ¥64.7B, operating income fell 3.0% to ¥11.1B and net income attributable rose 0.8% to ¥8.0B.

events.head: Lion nine-month operating profit up 62.7%
events.sum: Lion's nine-month 2025 net sales rose 1.3% to ¥304.9B and operating profit jumped 62.7% to ¥27.8B under IFRS.

events.head: Kao nine-month operating income rises 13.7% on cosmetics turnaround
events.sum: Kao reported nine-month 2025 net sales of ¥1,232.0B (+3.5%) and operating income of ¥114.9B (+13.7%), helped by a ¥10.9B swing in cosmetics profit; it kept its full-year targets of ¥1.69T sales and ¥165B operating income.

events.head: Henkel Q3 2025 sales €5.15B, organic growth 1.4%
events.sum: Henkel's third-quarter sales were €5,147M, down 6.3% nominally, with 1.4% organic growth. Consumer Brands grew 0.4% organically on sales of €2,402M.

events.head: Amorepacific Group Q3 operating profit rises 39% to KRW104.3bn
events.sum: Amorepacific Group's Q3 2025 revenue rose 3.8% to KRW1.108tn and operating profit 39.0% to KRW104.3bn; core unit Amorepacific grew revenue 4% to KRW1.017tn with overseas operating profit up 73%.

events.head: Nu Skin Q3 2025 revenue falls 15% to $364M
events.sum: Revenue declined 15.3% to $364.2M (11.5% excluding Mavely) while EPS rose to $0.34; Q4 revenue was guided to $365-$400M.

events.head: Mandom H1 operating income up 65%
events.sum: Mandom's April-September 2025 net sales rose 5.3% to ¥41.3B and operating income 65.4% to ¥2.4B; net income attributable rose 4.5% to ¥1.6B.

events.head: Proya Q3 2025 revenue falls 11.6%, profit down 23.6%
events.sum: Proya's Q3 2025 revenue fell 11.63% YoY to RMB1.736B and attributable profit dropped 23.64% to RMB227M; nine-month revenue was RMB7.10B (+1.9%) with net profit of RMB1.03B (+2.7%).

events.head: Mandom adopts defence policy as Murakami-linked City Index builds 17.6% stake
events.sum: Mandom's board adopted a response policy against large-scale share acquisition after City Index Eleventh and affiliates rapidly lifted their holding to 17.63% (18.87% of votes) during Kalon Holdings' pending MBO tender offer.

events.head: Clorox Q1 FY26 sales fall 19% as retailers unwind pre-ERP inventory
events.sum: Net sales dropped 19% to $1.43B (organic -17%) on the ERP-transition shipment hangover; adjusted EPS was $0.85 and the full-year outlook was held.

events.head: Kimberly-Clark to acquire Kenvue for $48.7B, creating a $32B health and wellness leader
events.sum: Cash-and-stock deal valuing Kenvue at $21.01 per share — $3.50 cash plus 0.14625 KMB shares, a roughly 46% premium. The combined group targets about $32B of annual revenue and $7B adjusted EBITDA, with roughly $1.9B of cost synergies over three years and Neutrogena and Aveeno joining the portfolio.

events.head: Proya files for Hong Kong listing to go A+H
events.sum: Proya submitted a listing application to the HKEX main board with CICC and UBS as joint sponsors, seeking a dual A+H listing; offering size not disclosed in the filing coverage.

events.head: Colgate Q3 2025 sales up 2%; organic growth guidance trimmed
events.sum: Net sales rose 2.0% to $5.13B with organic growth of just 0.4%; EPS was $0.91 and the full-year organic sales outlook was cut to 1-2%.

events.head: Church & Dwight Q3 2025 sales up 5%, outlook raised
events.sum: Net sales rose 5.0% to $1.586B with organic growth of 3.4%; adjusted EPS was $0.81 and full-year guidance was lifted, while the vitamin business was put under review.

media.sum: The amulet necklaces bring together Ouai’s signature scents and Heaven Mayhem’s vintage-inspired jewelry designs.

media.sum: Green, who sold her nail salon and products company two years ago, said "the customer has always been my number-one obsession — without them, nothing is possible."

media.sum: Marrone sees an opportunity to bring the brand’s founding principles back into focus as interest in preventative wellness and longevity grows.

media.sum: Giuseppe Marsocci spoke about the founder's aesthetic roadmap, cinematic roots, inspirations and lifestyle approach.

media.sum: At WWD x SKP Global Fashion & Beauty Summit in Wuhan, Eva Alexandridis and Olivia de Rothschild discussed the formative experiences that shaped their career and their personal understanding of longevity.

media.head: The Cast of ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ Brought Glow and Glam to the London Movie Premiere
media.sum: The upcoming installment in the dystopian franchise brought out the creative beauty in their Gen Z stars.

media.sum: Called Protect This Mind, Buffalo Bills safety Damar Hamlin will be the face of the wellness initiative.

media.head: Demi Lovato Sports Dark and Dramatic Glam at the First Airbnb.org Gala
media.sum: The multi-hyphenate announced a collaboration with Rare Beauty and longtime friend Selena Gomez before walking the red carpet on Wednesday.

media.head: Meet the Korean Wellness Brand Bringing Matcha to the Beauty Aisle
